public.title: Homepage
public.copy: Anyone can open the public landing page and see how the tournament works.

public.title: Fixtures
public.copy: Match list, current scores, and betting markets can be browsed without logging in.

public.title: Leaderboard
public.copy: People can follow the standings and bragging-rights race without getting player-level secrets.

private.title: Place bets
private.copy: Only invited friends with approved emails can submit or edit allowed bets before kickoff.

private.title: Personal history
private.copy: Each player can see their own bankroll, slip history, and pending exposure.

private.title: Admin tools
private.copy: Only the commissioner sees invite management, odds settings, and manual override tools.

inviteFlow.title: Share the public URL
inviteFlow.copy: You post the public site link in the group so everybody can follow the competition.

inviteFlow.title: Collect bettor emails
inviteFlow.copy: Only the friends who should actually play are added to the invited members list.

inviteFlow.title: Send Magic Link access
inviteFlow.copy: Supabase emails each invited bettor a one-time sign-in link tied to your allowed redirect URLs.

inviteFlow.title: Enforce membership at the database layer
inviteFlow.copy: Even after sign-in, bet writes only work if the logged-in user belongs to the tournament.

providerRegistry.name: Sportmonks
providerRegistry.bestFor: Real-time scores, lineups, live standings, and fast match status updates
providerRegistry.cadence: Every 60 seconds on match days, daily full sync at 06:00
providerRegistry.copy: This is the main data-mining source for the live version. It powers the matches table, live scoreboard refresh, and auto-settlement trigger.

providerRegistry.name: football-data.org
providerRegistry.bestFor: Cheaper MVP, delayed schedules, and low-frequency results sync
providerRegistry.cadence: Morning sync plus slower checks during match windows
providerRegistry.copy: This is the cheaper backup source. It is enough for fixture import and delayed result updates when you do not need a strong live experience.

sharingPlan.title: Public link
sharingPlan.copy: Share one public URL in WhatsApp, Discord, Instagram bio, or your group chat. Everyone can open it.

sharingPlan.title: Custom domain
sharingPlan.copy: Move from the Vercel subdomain to something like play.banterbank.app once branding matters.

sharingPlan.title: Invite-only betting
sharingPlan.copy: Bettors still need a Magic Link sign-in and a membership row in the tournament members table.

syncBlueprint.title: Fixture sync
syncBlueprint.copy: Pull all World Cup fixtures into your database every morning before people wake up.

syncBlueprint.title: Live sync
syncBlueprint.copy: Use the provider delta feed to mine only changed match records while games are active.

syncBlueprint.title: Status lock
syncBlueprint.copy: As soon as kickoff is reached, the match flips to locked and the bet form disables itself.

syncBlueprint.title: Settlement
syncBlueprint.copy: When the provider marks a fixture final, all open bets for that match are graded immediately.
